## What's new
- **PC Details loads faster.** All sections are now read from the PC at the same time instead of one after another, so the window waits for the slowest part rather than the total of all of them.
- **Cards fill in as they arrive.** Each card shows "Loading..." until its own data is ready, so you can start reading the PC and Utilization cards while slower parts (like Software or Device Manager) are still loading.
- **Load time in the header.** The header shows how long PC Details took to load. Hover it to see the time of each section.
- **Fewer round trips to the PC.** Shared WMI queries are made once, the Software card reuses the existing connection, running processes are read in a single pass, and the logged-in user's SID for the GPO User Date is looked up from your own PC.

## Upgrading from v5.1.0
- No Config files changed, so you can keep yours as they are.

## Download & run
Download `HelpDeskProTools-v5.1.1-win-x64-self-contained.zip`, extract it, and run `HelpDeskProTools.exe` (ideally as your `-admin` account).

This build is **self-contained**: .NET is included, so nothing needs to be installed on the PC. It runs as-is from a local folder or a file share.

## Requirements
- Windows 10/11 x64, domain-joined
- RSAT Active Directory tools (for AD Console)
- PowerShell 7 recommended for Remote PS and SFC Scan (Windows PowerShell 5.1 is used as a fallback)
- Target PCs: WinRM, the `c$` admin share and WMI/RPC reachable; `AllowRemoteRPC = 1` for Send Message
